profile.headline: Java Full Stack Developer | Full-time, W-2 employment only | Willing to relocate | H1B Holder | Looking for Sponsorship
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack Java software developer with 7.5 years of experience in Java and Javascript to build the restful web API. I have experience working on the banking system that helps the banker to calculate the plan so that their client can be able to pay for their mortgage. I also apply my experience to a gambling platform to create a wallet that helps my client manage their money. 

I have experience to co-work with international professional developers. And have strong knowledge about Java8, Spring family(boot, JPA, MVC), JS, React (Redux), MySQL, and using Jira and Git to manage the process and tasks in my last three companies. 

I can learn new technologies quickly and can work well in a team. I can adapt to any environment and hope that I can work in a professional place with many professional developers

I love coding and I want to devote my knowledge to build good software, that can support and bring the best value for everyone.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using the Java, Spring, React and UI tool to develop the trading system to display and manipulate the data from server side
•	Get the task from manager and analyze the requirement
•	Apply TDD to write the Unit test for each feature using Unit Test, Mocha, Jest, Sinon.
•	Start implement and fixing Bug in the application using React 
•	Testing and verify my work in UAT then notify for manager to testing on it.
•	Support and maintain my feature.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer: Played key role in developing software and features, providing multi-client support. 
•	Implement connection between POS and Clover machine base on requirement
•	Reading the document in the Clover’s homepage and implement connection
•	Support client at production.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 60A, Truong Son, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City
positions.description:
Project name: Seamless Wallet
Position: Java Full Stack Developer
Project Description: Developer of a popular gambling platform with a global user base.

Tasks Performed:
. Analyze online payment and deposit functions.
. Designed and a model data object, data flow base on the sample data and document from the third party.
. Developed the RESTful API (using spring framework) that consumes the request from a user, then validates and processes data.
. Built common functions for team members, follow the coding convention and design patterns. 
. Write unit testing for my function.
. Conducted code reviews
. Used JMeter to simulate network requests and conduct stress tests for API.
. Monitor and help to fixing bugs in production.


Accomplishments:
• Produced the document for the new feature.
• Developed the new feature the help to manage the balance in the new wallet
• Developed back-end API that consumes the request and protects data with the secure method.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 28 Truong Son, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City
positions.description:
Project name: Delivery Management
Position: Java Full Stack Developer
Project Description: Manage the project, manager, employee for the whole company

Tasks Performed:
. Discussed business requirements with team lead and identified technical solutions.
. Designed pages for each department. Wrote, tested, and reviewed code. 
. Researched emerging technologies and libraries; applied new solutions to improve software performance. 
. Refactored code and database to improve performance.

Accomplishments:
. Play a key role in the development and delivery of the new feature on time with high performance
. Complete the back-end and front-end of management tools and public the tools

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: 364 Cong Hoa, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City
positions.description:
Project name: Early Resolution
Position: Java Full Stack Developer
Project Description: Help the Banker manage the mortgage and calculate the plan so that their client can be able to pay for their mortgage

Assisted in developing a client-facing banking system that calculates mortgage plans. 

Tasks Performed: 
. Designed and implemented modules based on architectural design. 
. Conducted code testing and troubleshooting. 
. Supported QA process in preparation for the launch of new software modules

Accomplishments:
· Developed the financial income feature that helps the client to calculate the financial plan base on their input
· Designed and implemented a validation system that helps to correct the data before any process of business logic
